name: splicewire/laravel-beam-sitemap
description: The sitemap arm of the schemastud beam family (free-tier, ADR-0166): the SitemapSource contract + SitemapSourceRegistry + a /sitemap.xml controller + the chunked-generate command + the RouteSitemapSource MDX/static-page bridge — all relocated DOWN from laravel-satellite, which had zero satellite coupling. A sitemap is intrinsic to any beam site that serves public content, so the seam homes at the tier of the content, not the consumer-app backend. Base URL is a port (SitemapBaseUrlResolver) whose default returns config('app.url') — single-tenant/retrofit-safe. Consumers register their own sources onto the registry; the arm owns the plumbing, never the data.

package-topology.because: the sitemap arm is a lean, free-tier beam-family seam: pure Illuminate + Spatie, no upward reach into satellite/beam-ux/tenancy
